_meta.note: Health-score inputs, per 100 g. Score starts at base_score; each nutrient adds its (negative) impact when the value is STRICTLY greater than gt. Thresholds marked with the UK FSA source are the FSA 'high' cut-offs; the impact sizes (how many points each costs) are always a project heuristic. Beverages (per 100 ml, or a category listed in beverage_categories) use half of the thresholds listed in beverage_halved.
_meta.source: UK FSA front-of-pack nutrition labelling (traffic light) criteria, per 100 g: 'high' threshold
